faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Can't find your answer? Contact us or ask Droid on Telegram.

items.question: How do I place an order?
items.answer: Browse the store, add items to your cart and check out. You need a Pass to order; signing up takes a minute.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Payments are processed securely by Wayl, which supports local payment methods. Your order is confirmed once the payment succeeds.

items.question: Where do you deliver?
items.answer: We deliver to all 19 governorates of Iraq. The delivery fee, if any, is shown at checkout before you pay.

items.question: Can I return an item?
items.answer: Yes, under the conditions in our refund and returns policy. Contact us from your order in Your Pass or by email.

items.question: How does Plus work?
items.answer: You subscribe to a monthly plan. Each plan lets you keep a number of items at a time. Request a game, book or movie, we deliver it, and when you're done you return it and request the next one.

items.question: Can I buy from the store without Plus?
items.answer: Absolutely. The store is open to everyone; Plus is only needed for rentals.

items.question: How do I cancel?
items.answer: You can cancel your plan from Your Pass. It stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Please return any rented items.

items.question: Do I need to sign up separately for each service?
items.answer: No. One Pass works across the store, Plus, the Club and Partners.

items.question: How do I delete my Pass?
items.answer: You can delete it from the settings in Your Pass. Some records, such as invoices, are kept as the law requires.

items.question: How do I get help with an order or a rental?
items.answer: Sign in and open a support ticket from Help. You can follow our replies there. Without a Pass, email hi@theideaiq.com or use the contact form.

guide.title: For your developers
guide.flow: It's standard OpenID Connect: the authorization code flow with PKCE (S256). Send people to the authorization address from the discovery document; they come back to your return address with a code, which your server exchanges at the token endpoint.
guide.auth: Your server authenticates with the client secret (HTTP Basic or form fields) or, with keys below, a signed client assertion (private_key_jwt, ES256 or RS256, at most 5 minutes, a new jti each time). Never put the secret in a browser or a mobile app.
guide.scopes: Ask for openid plus the answers your app is registered for. People can untick any of them; the token response's scope lists what they shared. Each person has a different sub at each app.
guide.card: With the card answer, your server can fetch the person's card image (GET /oidc/card). To check a scanned Pass card at a door, POST its code to /oidc/card/check with your credentials.
guide.keys: After a new secret, the previous one keeps working for 24 hours so you can switch without downtime, unless you stop it.

authorize.meta: Sign in with The IDEA Pass
authorize.title: {site} wants you to sign in with The IDEA Pass
authorize.shares: If you continue, it learns (untick anything you don't want to share):

scopes.openid: That it's you (an id only this site sees)
scopes.profile: Your name, language and profile picture
scopes.student: Whether you're a verified student, at which university and until when
scopes.student_check: Only whether you're a verified student, at which university and until when (not your name, email or Pass)
scopes.plus: Whether you're a Plus member, and your plan
scopes.card: Your Pass card, to show on their site (without its scannable code)
scopes.pass: Your Pass number and since when you've had your Pass.
scopes.offline_access: Keep these up to date after you leave (for example, whether you're still a student) until you disconnect it
scopes.organizations: The organizations you belong to in Partners, and your role in each

authorize.never: It never sees anything you didn't tick, your orders or your payments. You can disconnect it at any time in Settings.
authorize.unknownTitle: This site can't use The IDEA Pass
authorize.unknown: The link that brought you here isn't from a site we know. Nothing was shared.
authorize.noStudentEmail: Not on file yet: confirm your university email in Settings to share it.
authorize.testing: This site is still being tested by its company: only the company's members can sign in for now.
authorize.testingOnly: This site is in testing, so only its company's members can sign in for now.

embed.unavailable: This site can't show The IDEA Pass card.
embed.intro: Show your live Pass card here, with the code {site} checks at the door.
embed.popupBlocked: The window couldn't open or connect back to this page.
embed.forget: Not you? Remove it from this browser

connect.title: Show your Pass card on {site}?
connect.body: Your card and its code, which changes every 30 seconds, will appear inside {site}'s pages, shown by theideaiq.com. {site} doesn't receive them. You can stop it any time in Pass → Settings.
connect.done: Done. You can close this window.
connect.again: You're signed in. Go back to {site} and press “Show my Pass card” again.
connect.notAllowed: This site can't show your Pass card yet.
connect.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.

verify.title: Verify you're a student
verify.description: Your university email and the code we send it. That's all: no sign-up.
verify.universityEmail: Your university email: we'll send it an 8-digit code.
verify.cardEmail: Your email, so we can tell you the result. Then a photo of your student card.
verify.useCard: No university email? Use your student card
verify.notUniversityEmail: Verify with your university email or a photo of your student card.
verify.waiting: Your student card is waiting for review. We'll email you the result.

choose.title: You're verified. What now?
choose.onceHint: The result goes only to whoever asked. We keep nothing but a 30-day record against abuse.
choose.keepHint: Student prices, Plus at 20% off, student perks and student surveys work without asking again, until {date}.

result.codeHint: Show it to a partner; they check it in Partners. It works until {time}.

verify.deleteHint: It's deleted at once. If you got a Pass only for this check, it's deleted too.

errors.tooMany: Too many checks. Try again later.
